subject.title: Subagent announce give-up (retry-limit/expiry) does not wake parent waiting on sessions_yield → permanent deadlock

question: Should #90178 close after the narrow blocked-delivery parent wake fix lands, or should closure require the broader durable completion queue and explicit tool-result closure work?
rationale: Current main proves the bug remains, but the permanent product boundary between narrow wake recovery, durable delivery architecture, and retry config surface needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Land narrow wake recovery
options.body: Treat #95080 or an equivalent patch as the closure path for this issue, while tracking durable queue and config knobs in separate issues.

options.title: Require durable queue first
options.body: Keep #90178 open until completion announcements are persisted and redelivered through a durable queue or session event mechanism.

options.title: Bundle retry configuration
options.body: Expand the fix scope to include public retry/expiry knobs, accepting the extra config contract and migration review burden.

recommendation.title: Land narrow wake recovery
recommendation.body: Treat #95080 or an equivalent patch as the closure path for this issue, while tracking durable queue and config knobs in separate issues.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent lifecycle and delivery-state history makes this the best available owner for the wake-vs-durable-queue product boundary.
